text.p: Band-Ore Resources Ltd said on Tuesday that new drilling results enhance the company's gold project in the Timmins area of Northern Ontario.

Drilling from a new discovery zone near the company's main Golder River zone showed a grade of 4.5 grams of gold per tonne over a width of five metres, including one section containing 6.3 grams of gold per tonne over three metres, the company said.
The hole was 50 metres to the south of a previously reported hole in the same zone.
The company also reported results from the Golden River zone.
The best results from that zone included 83.3 grams of gold per tonne over 1.1 metres, 11.6 grams per tonne over six metres and 7.5 grams per tonne over 3.2 metres.
The results extend the strike length on the Thorne property to 600 metres from 425 metres, company spokesman Jonathan Armes said in an interview.
